The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e75bfb353c2d3374), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 106. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix K0, M0 as in Lemma 13.4. There exist C, c > 0, independent of N ≥ K0, |s| ≤ R, and k ≥ 0, such that the following hold for β = ϑN + s. Let (u1, u2) ∈ A and (n, w) = (u1, u2)2kM0LN . If a bounded local observable F has support contained in a rectangle of time extent at most n/2 and spatial extent at most w/2, then |µβ;n,w(F) − µβ(F)| ≤ C∥F∥∞e−c2k . (13.8) The same bound holds when time is closed by any integer spatial translation, provided the support has a lift satisfying these two extent bounds. The constant is uniform in the closing translation. If two bounded local plane observables F, G have supporting slabs separated by d ≥ 0 transfer edges, in either microscopic axial direction, then | Covµβ (F, G)| ≤ ∥F∥∞∥G∥∞e−(log 2)d/(M0LN ) . (13.9) For complex observables the covariance uses FG.
